title: Field Elm: Old Field Elms You Can Visit
meta_description: The elm Dutch elm disease hit hardest. Sliven's Old Elm, about a thousand years by tradition, won European Tree of the Year in 2014.
intro: Ulmus minor was the species Dutch elm disease hit hardest, so every big field elm still standing has outlived nearly all of its kind. Sliven's Old Elm, beside the town hall, is put at about a thousand years by tradition, won European Tree of the Year in 2014 and is on a Bulgarian coin; the disease reached it too, and specialists are keeping two low branches alive. The Olmo de Navajas in Valencia province was planted in 1636 by a settler named Roque Pastor and is still the centre of the village square. In Romania, the elm of Căpeni is 7.3 metres round. French has a phrase for being kept waiting, wait for me under the elm, and the elm in question stands in front of Saint-Gervais in Paris: the present one was planted in 1935, on a spot that has carried an elm since the Middle Ages.
